turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How may I help you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been having difficulties breathing over these last few days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: When did it start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It started about, like, three or four days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and since then, has it gotten any better or worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It has, maybe gotten a little bit worse, but not, maybe, a little worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And are there certain times when you feel that you're more short of breath than other times? Anything in particular that you're doing that makes it worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, not really, it's kind of, I just feel like, it's just more difficult to breathe, uh, most of the time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And, has this happened to you before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, not like, no, nothing like this has happened before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have a history of any lung problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't, I've been healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So no COPD, no asthma, nothing like that,  right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you're just having difficulties breathing for the past three-four days. Do you have any, uh, do you have a cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did have a, uh, yeah, I've had a cough as well, over these last few days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And has it been a dry cough or wet cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been bringing up, some, like, uh, whitish sputum. It's like, yeah, whitish or clear.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And you haven't seen blood anytime right? In your sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has the cough gotten any worse overtime?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it's been about the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you had fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have felt hot but no chills.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. What about, any redness in your eyes or any congestion in your nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I haven't noticed anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had a sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it's felt a little itchy I guess but no pain with swallowing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you have any chest pain or chest pressure?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, when I like, uh, take a deep breath or after after I cough I've been having some chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: To give it a number from one to ten, what would you say in terms of how severe it is with ten being the worst pain ever.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say, maybe six. It feels pretty sharp when it happens and it goes away after a few minutes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and where exactly is it, is the pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, I kind of feel it, Yeah, just over on the right side of the sternum.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, and does it radiate anywhere? Does it go anywhere other than that one location?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I feel it just in the one spot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and has that pain gotten worse overtime?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that pain started, I guess like two days ago. More recent than the cough or shortness of breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, I see, OK. And so you said that coughing makes it worse and sometimes breathing in. So is it just normal breathing or when you're doing like, deep breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Deep breathing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Deep breathing hurts? OK. Alright, and you've never experienced this before, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had a pain like this before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, when you sort of touch that area over your chest, does touching it make it worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no, I haven't noticed that, touching it doesn't make it worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, alright, have you had a headache?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. What about fatigue or muscle aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been fatigued. No muscle aches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any pain in your belly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Constipation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any changes in your, uh, any changes when you pee?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, nothing there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No. OK. Any rash that you've noticed on your skin?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any changes in your sense of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Changes in your sense of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright. So sounds like for the past three-four days you've had difficulties breathing and a cough with this whitish sputum, whitish or clear sputum. You've also been feeling a little bit feverish. Have you checked your temperature?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't. I don't have a thermometer at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, no problem and your throat's been a little bit itchy and then two days ago you also started having this pain in your chest. Is there any other symptom that I have not mentioned that you have been experiencing over the past couple of days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that's everything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK. And you mentioned that you don't have a history of asthma or COPD. Do you have any other medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure. And I take Amlodipine, for that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK any other over the counter medications or any other medication that you're on?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No allergies.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and where do you currently live?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: In a townhouse just outside of the city here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, do you live alone?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I live with my wife and daughter.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have your wife and daughter been sick recently or have either of you had contact with someone who's been sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been working from home, uhm, but my daughter has recently started going back to high school and she's had a runny nose recently and a sore throat, but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what about your wife?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: She's been fine. Yeah, she's been healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good. Other than your daughter, have you been in contact with anyone else who might have, who might be sick or might have symptoms similar to what your daughter has?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright, and do you, have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been just, uh, working from home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ever smoked in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've never smoked before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I mean, I'll have a joint sometimes with friends at a party or something, but that's maybe once a month?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sure, and any street drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have a beer a couple of times per week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and you told me about your medical history, but do you have, have you ever had any surgeries or any hospitalizations in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I've had a hernia repair, about seven years ago. I haven't had any issues since.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, OK, uhm, and are there any medical conditions that run in your family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, my grand-father had a heart attack, in his seventies. And, I think my dad has high blood pressure as well, but, I think that's it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, well, so, I think that's all that I wanted to know. I can see that you haven't been feeling well over the past couple of days and I'll go back to my attending and we will come back and chat with you little bit more and do a physical exam and go from there.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sounds good, thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome.
